score_working: Graded events by recency, weights 5..1: Q3 FY26 (1.00) x5, Q1 FY26 (0.00) x4, Q4 FY25 (1.25) x3, Q3 FY25 (2.00) x2, Q2 FY25 (2.00) x1 = 14.75; weights sum to 15; 14.75/15 x 5 = 4.9. Pending and not_retrieved events and the outside_window entry carry no weight.
notes: Quote caveat: transcript quotes are extractions from AlphaStreet pages returned by WebFetch (summarised, not raw HTML) and may carry ASR errors; speaker labels are sometimes garbled. Spot-check against NSE/BSE transcript filings before relying on any quote.

Grade-once rule: each promise is graded once at its first statement in the window. Repeats are folded into notes: 800 cr quarterly revenue (first Q4 FY25; repeated Q1 FY26, Q3 FY26); AI revenue of about 200 cr (first Q1 FY26; repeated Q3 FY26); the Q1 FY26 margin band of 22-25% is a revision of the Q4 FY25 24-25% promise and is graded against the original.

EBITDA margin basis: the company appears to quote margin on total income (FY26: EBITDA 703.03 cr / total income 3,160.76 cr = 22.2%; on revenue from operations of 3,042.97 cr = 23.1%). The Q4 FY25 margin promise is graded 0 on total income and would be 1 on revenue from operations.
Q1 FY27 and Q4 FY26 are pending because they are too recent. Their promises are paraphrased from AI summaries of the transcripts, not opened transcripts. Speakers are unattributed.

Q1 FY27 commitment of a dedicated AI investor call by 30 Sep 2026 has fallen due. No intimation or filing was found, but BSE/NSE announcements for Aug-Oct 2026 were not checked directly, so it is left ungraded.
FY26 AI revenue of about 160 cr rests on the Chairman's statement on the Q4 FY26 call. It is not in any filing, and the company does not report AI revenue as a line item.
Q4 FY24 (May 2024) origin trace is graded 0.5 as an outside_window entry and is excluded from score_10.

Possible silent softening of long-run targets, to be judged at their deadlines: 30% EBITDA margin (stated Oct 2024, Jan 2025, May 2025) versus a 20-25% range on the Q4 FY26 call; 4,000 cr revenue target drifting from 'PBT 1,000 cr' (Jul 2025) to 'EBITDA 1,000 cr' and from FY29 to FY28.
